name: Strix
description: Finding working streams for your cameras. Most IP cameras - especially Chinese NVRs and budget models - come with zero documentation. No RTSP URLs, no protocol specs, no way to connect them to Frigate. Strix solves this by matching your camera against a database of over 100,000 URL patterns for 67,000 models, testing them and returning only working streams.
short_desc: IP camera stream discovery tool for Frigate
author: eduard256
